sense_window: Stored LF snapshot versus current CRLF authority and missing historical P16 whole ancestry.
symptom: Historical coordinate debt existed even though the preserved interval hash was exact.

cause_evidence.detail: Historical P16 whole file and pointer path are unavailable; only the preserved interval survived.
Canon owner independently rebound the complete interval by strict newline normalization.

attempted_approaches.approach: Treat historical P16 coordinates as current authority.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Rejected because the whole file is missing and non-replayable.

attempted_approaches.approach: Request coordinate-only canon binder.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Accepted; normalized identity to ED0001 and named public layers was returned.

rejected_approaches: Do not infer a whole-file ancestry edge to missing P16.
Do not treat R823 Analogon/Anologon lineage delta as a translator-confirmed defect.
resolution: Pointer v003 and the immutable P41 binder close coordinate/tooling debt for this exact interval.
residual_risk: R823 retains a one-token divergent ancestor reading and original-print adjudication remains absent.
recurrence_cues: raw byte inequality caused solely by CRLF/LF
branch token difference without checker evidence
transferable_lesson: Bind a preserved unit directly to a current content-addressed authority; never let missing whole ancestry invalidate a normalized-identical unit.
revisit_condition: Revisit only if a checker-confirmed primary-source finding is submitted under pointer v003.

sense_window: Hangul/Hanja and South-/North-Korean standards cannot be inferred from Chinese/Japanese cognates.
symptom: No accessible Korean-native historical algebra corpus or ko-KP evidence authorized the new lexicon.

cause_evidence.detail: The surviving local custody shelf is Mandarin-Simplified-dominant and target-disjoint.
Cross-language cognacy creates a lexical-attractor risk but not Korean evidence.

attempted_approaches.approach: Infer Hanja and pan-Korean terms from Chinese/Japanese forms.
Use Hangul-first ko-KR and expose all new terms.

rejected_approaches: Do not convert Mandarin-Simplified dominance into a readiness score.
Do not claim ko-KP equivalence.
resolution: Keep Hanja/ko-KP decisions open and require language-specific evidence.

evidence.detail: Explicit evidence debt and regional/script boundary.

residual_risk: Some fluent-looking Sino-Korean choices may be unattested or regionally marked.
transferable_lesson: Language-specific evidence debt must remain visible even when target prose is fluent.
revisit_condition: Independent Korean and ko-KP specialists must return explicit evidence.

symptom: The historical scope contrast can be flattened or activated by ordinary-language meanings.

cause_evidence.detail: Source footnote explicitly distinguishes im Minimalen from im Kleinen.
Producer uses 주종정리, 최소형, 소형 without Korean attestation.

attempted_approaches.approach: Collapse both scope labels into one generic small case.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Rejected because it erases the source contrast.

attempted_approaches.approach: Use 주종정리 / 최소형 / 소형 provisionally.

rejected_approaches: Do not treat principal genus as ordinary main type.
Do not normalize the paired scope labels independently.
resolution: Checker must bind the theorem name and paired labels as one terminology family.
residual_risk: A global replacement may be needed across title, formulations, and proof references.
transferable_lesson: Resolve historically linked terminology as a family, not token by token.

sense_window: verschränktes Produkt; verschränkte Darstellung; Faktorensystem; assoziiert; Transformationsgrößen.
symptom: Several coupled cohomological senses invite literal or mutually inconsistent translations.

cause_evidence.detail: Displayed relations tie all five terms into one concept family.
Producer uses 교차곱, 교차표현, 인자계, 연관된, 변환량.

attempted_approaches.approach: Translate verschränkt literally as 얽힌.
Use crossed-product family and log cohomological equivalence debt.

rejected_approaches: Do not replace assoziiert locally without checking all factor-system relations.
resolution: Require one checker-owned terminology map across definitions, formulas, and representation classes.
residual_risk: 연관된 may be weaker than cohomological equivalence; 교차표현 may lack Korean attestation.
transferable_lesson: Map a coupled mathematical vocabulary family before approving any individual term.

symptom: Historical order/module/normal-algebra vocabulary collides with modern Korean senses and prior producer choices.

cause_evidence.detail: P41 uses 극대차수 while P42 used 극대 오더.
einfache normale Algebra likely has the central-simple sense; historical Modul is module, not modulus.

attempted_approaches.approach: Silently normalize P41 to the P42 loanword.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Rejected because that would be unreviewed terminology editing.

attempted_approaches.approach: Expose both producer choices to a checker.

rejected_approaches: Do not confuse Ordnung with degree/order in invariant theory.
Do not read normal as merely normal ring.
resolution: P41/P42 conflict remains explicit; checker must choose corpus-wide forms.
residual_risk: An approved replacement must propagate across multiple papers and structural roles.
transferable_lesson: Cross-paper inconsistency is adverse evidence to surface, not permission for an unreviewed global edit.

locators: class partition and principal genus statements

sense_window: Klasseneinteilung; Hauptklasse; Einsklasse; Hauptgeschlecht; ambig; Basiselement.
symptom: Short Korean calques can activate everyday meanings rather than ideal-class structure.

cause_evidence.detail: Producer uses 류분할, 주류, 일류, 주종, 모호(ambig), 생성원.
ambig denotes Galois-invariant/ambiguous ideal classes; Basiselement may mean an ideal generator.

attempted_approaches.approach: Use only literal 모호 and 일류 without gloss.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Held because fixed-class and identity-class senses may disappear.

attempted_approaches.approach: Retain source glosses and expose alternatives.

rejected_approaches: Do not let 일류 attract first-rate meaning.
Do not decide Basiselement without its ideal-generator context.
resolution: Checker must approve a relation-aware class-field-theory lexicon.
residual_risk: Local substitutions can break the explicit equivalence among three formulations.
transferable_lesson: Class terminology must preserve relations, not just surface cognates.

sense_window: Modulsumme; Zerlegungsgruppe; unverzweigter Trägheitskörper; normierte zyklische Darstellung; Normenrest.
symptom: Historical local arithmetic terms are false-friend prone and are embedded in a proof chain.

cause_evidence.detail: Source itself glosses Modulsumme as greatest common divisor and derives local splitting via unramified units.
Producer uses 가군합, 분해군, 비분기 관성체, 정규화된 순환표현, 노름잉여.

attempted_approaches.approach: Translate Modulsumme as an abstract module direct sum.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Rejected because source gives the ideal gcd convention.

attempted_approaches.approach: Use modern local-field calques with historical sense windows.

rejected_approaches: Do not normalize historical Trägheitskörper without local-field evidence.
Do not read Normenrest as a numerical remainder.
resolution: Checker must review the local terminology and the source convention as one proof segment.

sense_window: TeX inline-math delimiters in target serialization.
symptom: A normal JavaScript string consumed backslashes before inline math delimiters in the first U01-U04 patch payload.

cause_evidence.detail: Worker reported the escaping failure and repaired it before the frozen hashes.
Failed pre-repair hashes are unavailable because hashing occurred only after repair.

attempted_approaches.approach: Write TeX through an unescaped normal JavaScript string.
Restore delimiters with apply_patch before freezing identities.

rejected_approaches: Never invent unavailable failed hashes.
Do not call delimiter restoration formula review.
resolution: Final U01-U04 hashes freeze repaired producer bytes; failure remains append-only.
residual_risk: Other TeX escapes could fail if future patch payloads repeat the same string path.
recurrence_cues: inline math appears as plain parentheses
transferable_lesson: Protect TeX escapes at serialization time and preserve failures even when repair precedes hashing.
revisit_condition: Recur if any producer target is written through a normal unescaped JavaScript string.

sense_window: TeX inline-math delimiter loss with frozen before/after identities.
symptom: First-return U05-U08 files lost backslashes before many inline delimiters; a first bulk-repair approach was reported unsuccessful before exact local repairs.

cause_evidence.detail: Worker identified the same JavaScript escape class during structural line inventory.
All four damaged and repaired hashes are retained in CJK-KO-P41-002.

attempted_approaches.approach: Accept first-return hashes.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Rejected because bytes were mechanically damaged.

attempted_approaches.approach: First bulk repair.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Failed; detailed transient output was not preserved by the worker, which is retained as evidence limitation.

attempted_approaches.approach: Exact per-file apply_patch delimiter restoration.
attempted_approaches.outcome: Accepted; wording unchanged and new hashes frozen.

rejected_approaches: Do not erase first-return hashes.
Do not invent the missing transient bulk-repair output.
resolution: Final repaired identities supersede damaged bytes only; both states remain in the ledger.

evidence.detail: Exact before/after identities and repair scope.

residual_risk: Repeated serialization paths can recreate the same defect; failed bulk-repair diagnostics are incomplete.
recurrence_cues: target byte increase equals restored delimiters
worker sees plain parentheses around symbols
transferable_lesson: Freeze and retain both damaged and repaired hashes; scope repairs to mechanical serialization only.
revisit_condition: Recur on any TeX target whose first write used unescaped JavaScript strings.

sense_window: Markdown TeX delimiters in the terminology evidence file.
symptom: The first choices-file patch used a normal JavaScript string and stripped backslashes from several Markdown math spans.

cause_evidence.detail: Root observed forms such as (mathfrak G^*) after the write.
Repair preceded hashing, so no failed-file hash exists.

attempted_approaches.approach: Keep malformed Markdown math.
Restore exact delimiters with apply_patch and then hash.

rejected_approaches: Do not conflate metadata formatting repair with target review.
Do not fabricate a failed hash.
resolution: Final choices file is frozen at 46AF7C...; target TeX was not changed.
residual_risk: The same serialization bug affects Markdown containing TeX as well as TeX targets.
recurrence_cues: metadata looks readable but math markup is gone
transferable_lesson: Apply the same escape discipline to evidence metadata as to target TeX.
revisit_condition: Recur whenever Markdown evidence embeds TeX through JavaScript strings.

Failure occurred before any write; repaired command used an explicit output array.

attempted_approaches.approach: foreach { object } | ConvertTo-Json.
Collect into task-specific array, then pipe the array.

rejected_approaches: Do not erase repeated parser failures because later commands succeed.

sense_window: PowerShell variable immediately followed by colon in structural-builder diagnostics.
symptom: The first structural builder run failed with a parser error on $unit: before generated output was accepted.

cause_evidence.detail: PowerShell parsed the colon as part of an invalid variable reference.
Changing only $unit: to ${unit}: allowed the same builder to run; deterministic rerun reproduced hashes.

attempted_approaches.approach: Use unbraced variable before colon.
Brace the variable and rerun.

rejected_approaches: Do not treat a metadata validator pass as translation validation.
resolution: Braced interpolation repaired the builder; generated index/report are current.
residual_risk: Similar diagnostic strings can fail before validators run.
transferable_lesson: Validator failures belong in the same append-only history they are designed to protect.
revisit_condition: Recur if a future PowerShell diagnostic interpolates an unbraced variable before punctuation.
